com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.account
Self-service account REST API: registration, e-mail verification, password change and password reset.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.account
Use cases of the account lifecycle: registration, e-mail verification, password change and reset.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.social
Use cases of social login (identity brokering): resolving a sign-in with an external provider to an account (finding it, linking by verified e-mail address, or provisioning it), linking, unlinking and listing the identities of an account.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.account
Account lifecycle: registration, e-mail verification, password change and reset.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.keys
Signing keys of the authorization server: key encryption and generation, the JWK sources and the signed token service built on them.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.mail
Mail adapter of the authorization server: delivers one-time tokens and account e-mails.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.account
PostgreSQL implementation of the account token port, over the account_tokens table.
